### The Restoration Stumbles
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/restoration-stumbles
Passage: Haggai 2:20-23
Points:
- God's overarching purpose since the Fall has been to restore righteous human dominion over creation.
- Although Israel's kings repeatedly broke covenant and suffered exile, the Lord remained faithful to David's royal line.
- The Lord designated Zerubbabel as His signet ring, symbolizing divine authority and the renewal of Davidic leadership.
- Zerubbabel did not establish an everlasting throne in his lifetime, demonstrating the conditional nature of prophetic promises.
- The signet ring promise finds its ultimate fulfillment in Jesus Christ, who shares His kingdom with His redeemed people.
